definition: In the local typed Model, Nature ranges over candidate natures and BodilyNature selects natures of bodies. CanUnderstand intellect n is capacity to understand that nature. UniversalBodilyCognition quantifies over every selected bodily nature, distributively. It neither asserts an actual exercise nor simultaneous omniscience. The intellectual principle is designated by a parameter; no universal predicate of all kinds of cognition or of divine knowing is introduced.
note: The older primitive HasIntellect has no cognitive-domain semantics. This first human-intellect argument is not the converse of the highest-immateriality premise of q.14.
